This script analyzes oyster size over time.   

# Set Up    

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE)
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(stringr)
library(readxl)
library(purrr)
library(lubridate)
library(ggplot2)
library(seacarb)
library(broom)
library(cowplot)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
```

# Read in files 

Read in files to be reformatted. 
```{r}
#data<-read_csv("data/size/size_20260814.csv")%>%select(!site)%>%select(!image)%>%select(!notes)
  
#data<-data%>%pivot_wider(names_from="measurement", values_from="value.mm")

#write_csv(data, file="data/size/size_20260814_alt.csv")
```

Read in data 
```{r}
data<-read_csv("data/size/growth.csv")%>%select(!notes)%>%select(!initials)

metadata<-read_xlsx("data/metadata/experiment_metadata.xlsx")
```

Join data together. 

```{r}
data<-left_join(data, metadata)
head(data)
```

# Calculate oyster volume 

Calculate volume using equations as an ellipsoid.

```{r}
calc_oyster_volume <- function(length_mm, width_mm, k = 0.21) {
  k * length_mm * (width_mm^2)
}

data$volume.mm3 <- calc_oyster_volume(data$length.mm, data$width.mm)
```

View data. 
```{r}
hist(data$volume.mm3)
```

# Analyze size over time

```{r}
data<-data%>%
  mutate(tag=as.factor(tag))%>%
  mutate(date=as.factor(date))
```

```{r}
plot1<-data%>%
  
  ggplot(aes(x=date, y=volume.mm3, color=treatment))+
  facet_wrap(~tag, nrow=2)+
  geom_boxplot()+
  geom_point(position=position_dodge(0.75))+
  scale_color_manual(values=c("cyan3", "coral"))+
  ylab("Volume (mm3)")+
  xlab("Family")+
  theme_classic(); plot1
```

We are missing photos of tags 76, 77, 78, and 79 (YC24-099) from the initial time point. 

Look at only final size. 

```{r}
plot2<-data%>%
  filter(date=="20260814")%>%
  
  ggplot(aes(x=family, y=volume.mm3, color=treatment))+
  geom_boxplot()+
  geom_point(position=position_dodge(0.75))+
  scale_color_manual(values=c("cyan3", "coral"))+
  ylab("Volume (mm3)")+
  xlab("Family")+
  theme_classic(); plot2

ggsave(plot2, filename="figures/size/family_size.png", width=8, height=4)
```

Run a model. 

```{r}
model<-data%>%
  filter(date=="20260814")%>%
  
  lmer(volume.mm3 ~ family * treatment + (1|tag) + (1|cage), data=.)

anova(model)
```

Family is significant, treatment effects are not significant.  

# Analyze growth 

```{r}
plot1<-data%>%
  
  ggplot(aes(x=date, y=volume.mm3, color=treatment, fill=treatment, group=interaction(date, treatment)))+
  facet_wrap(~family, nrow=2)+
  #geom_boxplot()+
  geom_point(position=position_jitterdodge(0.1), alpha=0.6)+
  geom_smooth(method="loess", aes(group=treatment))+
  scale_color_manual(values=c("cyan3", "coral"))+
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("cyan3", "coral"))+
  ylab("Volume (mm3)")+
  xlab("Date")+
  theme_classic()+
  theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=45, vjust=0.5)); plot1

ggsave(plot1, filename="figures/size/family_growth_rate.png", width=10, height=6)
```

Analyze growth to include date.

Run a model. 

```{r}
model<-data%>%
  #filter(!family=="YC24-099")%>%
  
  lmer(volume.mm3 ~ date * family * treatment + (1|tag) + (1|cage), data=.)

summary(model)
anova(model, type=2)

library(emmeans)

emm <- emmeans(model, ~ date * family * treatment)
pairs(emm, by = c("date", "family"), adjust = "tukey")
```

There are some interactive effects present between date x family x treatment. But model is rank deficient. Will need to use date as a random effect.

Run a model with date as a random effect. 

```{r}
model2<-data%>%
  #filter(!family=="YC24-099")%>%
  
  lmer(volume.mm3 ~ family * treatment + (1|tag) + (1|cage) + (1|date), data=.)

summary(model2)
anova(model2, type=2)

emm <- emmeans(model2, ~ family * treatment)
pairs(emm, by = c("family"), adjust = "tukey")
```

Family only, no treatment effects. 

Type II Analysis of Variance Table with Satterthwaite's method

family:treatment 1.3733e+09  152588079     9 15.1283  1.1940    0.3652    

Compare models
```{r}
aov(model, model2)
```
